title: Memex Agentic Memory Graph Maintenance Loop
constraints: Start with dry-run previews and explicit validation gates
Preserve user data surfaces: do not mutate vaults, trackers, or remote systems until dry-run plans pass
Emit machine-readable artifacts agents can resume

metadata.outcome: A scheduled or on-demand maintenance project that converts session learnings into atomic cards, repairs graph topology, keeps semantic spines healthy, and validates graph health before sync.

nodes.title: Start with scored recall packet
nodes.content: Retrieve task-specific memex cards with compact results, then read only necessary leaf cards.

nodes.title: Observe session decisions and gotchas
nodes.content: Identify durable insights from actual work: architecture decisions, root causes, conventions, and repeated mistakes.

nodes.title: Write atomic linked cards
nodes.content: Use memex_retro for one insight per card; link through semantic spines or canonical hubs rather than direct index sprawl.

nodes.title: Repair topology and unresolved aliases
nodes.content: Run scoped organize/doctor/topology scripts; create routing hubs for repeated unresolved concepts, but avoid maintenance-card PageRank bloat.

nodes.title: Sync and verify graph health
nodes.content: Run doctor/topology metrics and sync only scoped card/report files; never commit derived embeddings caches.

nodes.title: Generate next-session wakeup brief
nodes.content: Emit compact AAAK-style context for future agents: decisions, gotchas, open loops, and relevant card slugs.

edges.description: new memory must be informed by existing graph context to avoid duplicates
healthy graph topology improves future wakeup packet quality
